_comment: Every FBISE document the content pipeline reads, with the subject it belongs to.
SSC-I is Class 9 and SSC-II is Class 10: the site mixes them in the same folders,
so only SSC-I entries belong here. Paths are literal, spaces and all; the fetcher
URL-encodes them. Verified returning HTTP 200 on 11 Aug 2026.
kind: 'curriculum' carries the SLOs, 'framework' carries the mark distribution,
'practicals' the examinable experiments, 'reference' is background we read but do not parse.
